coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 15B (UCSF planned)

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary, formed from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.

milestones.text: Same finding as 15A: the Dec 2019 map shows 15B in the 'UCSF' color (no use type; UCSF's own June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing), and the Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows block 15 as a single undivided block without UCSF color

changes.text: Block 15B's notes and milestone said the 2019 land use map designates this block for UCSF institutional use; the map only colors it 'UCSF', and UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck lists Block 15 as Housing, so the use is corrected to residential and the deck is cited for the planned status. The current-parking statement is now labelled our observation in USDA NAIP imagery.

record.notes: No building on the site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'); parked cars fill the block in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation that no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this block 'UCSF' (no use type); UCSF's own June 2025 deck, citing its Long Range Development Plan, lists Block 15 as Housing. No specific project, developer, or timeline was found.
